Site-side: the summary extractor moves off the lead, articles get an auto table of contents. Design: plan.md. Reference style: https://inpa.tistory.com/

tasks.title: Rewrite the authoring rules in docs/rules/wiki-content.md
tasks.acceptance: §1 'Body' no longer mandates a lead paragraph; the phase-10 bullet is replaced by the §3 per-type required headings (concepts: 한눈에 요약 / 함께 읽기; entities: 한눈에 요약 / 이 위키에서의 등장 / 함께 읽기; analysis: 결론 먼저 / 비교표 / 함께 읽기) with the note that the first summary bullet is what site/build.py extracts, so it carries no citation paren and no wikilink and must read standalone. Two new §1 subsections: '쉽게 쓰기 규칙' (plan §4-1, eight rules) and '어투' (plan §4-2, five rules plus the two carve-outs and the explicit non-adoptions). File stays English per the CLAUDE.md language rule, Korean only in the heading literals and specimens.

tasks.title: Add check_page_structure() to scripts/lint_wiki.py
tasks.acceptance: New check reporting, per page type: (a) ERROR when a required heading from the T02 table is missing, (b) ERROR when prose sits between the H1 and the first '## ' on a concept/entity/analysis page (leftover lead), (c) WARN on a legacy closing heading '## 관련 문서' / '## 같이 보기' / '## 연결', (d) WARN on an H2 section over 1200 chars, (e) WARN on a sentence over 100 chars outside code fences and tables. Runs over wiki/ only. Warnings do not change the exit code, errors do. Existing checks and their output format unchanged; a unit test covers one passing and one failing page per rule class.

tasks.title: Rewrite concepts batch 1 — the four longest
tasks.acceptance: Each page: lead paragraph removed, '## 한눈에 요약' (3-5 bullets, first bullet standalone with no citation and no wikilink) and '## 함께 읽기' present, closing heading renamed, H3 introduced wherever an H2 ran over 1200 chars, sentences under 100 chars, paragraphs at most four sentences, jargon glossed on first use, comparisons of three or more items turned into tables, caveats moved into blockquote callouts, voice per plan §4-2 with sourced claims left declarative. No source slug disappears from a page and every claim keeps a citation; the raw citation count may drop slightly where two adjacent sentences citing the same source were merged into one. Every wikilink target still resolves. frontmatter updated bumped to 2026-08-03. check_page_structure reports no error for these files.
